report.summary: daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py: Provides a subprocess adapter (SubprocessAdapter) for running configured CLI commands in a bounded working directory and normalizing output into a standard event stream. Defines RuntimeConfig, RUNTIME_PROFILES, and PromptMode as supporting types.
risks: DEPENDS|daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|.events (AgentCapabilities, AgentEvent, AgentMessage, CommandOutput, SessionEnded, SessionStarted, TextDelta, ToolCompleted, ToolRequested, event_to_transport_record)
CLAIMS|daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|one-shot CLI profiles do not expose a portable approval protocol (in approve/reject methods)
CLAIMS|daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|each CLI still needs a verified command profile and provider-specific event parser (module docstring)
todos: daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|constant|PromptMode|Restricts prompt delivery mode to one of "argument", "stdin", or "none".
daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|class|RuntimeConfig|Verified process-launch contract for one CLI runtime.
daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|constant|RUNTIME_PROFILES|Provides built-in runtime profiles for one-shot, non-interactive CLI invocations.
daedalus/adapters/subprocess_adapter.py|class|SubprocessAdapter|Runs a configured CLI in a bounded working directory and normalizes output into AgentEvents.
